en.title: Contact & Support – Claimo
en.description: Help with the Claimo app: questions about your account, balance, credits and payouts. Contact Claimo support by form or email.
en.heading: How can we help?
en.lead: Questions about your account, your balance or a payout? Write to us – we reply by email.
en.mailSub: Screenshots or proof can go in as attachments
tips: Use the email address of your Claimo account so we can find it.
Missing credit: tell us the offer, the time frame and any proof – and contact the provider’s support as well.
Never send us passwords or voucher codes. We will never ask for your password.
links: In the app or by email
en.fieldEmailHint: Ideally the address of your Claimo account.
en.privacy: When you send the form, your name, email address and message are transmitted to us via the form service Web3Forms. Details: {link}.
en.msgError: That didn’t work. Please try again or email support@claimo-app.com directly.
en.successText: Thanks! We will reply by email to {email}.
